info.title: Anovra Platform API
info.description: Interactive API documentation for Anovra authentication, role-based dashboards, vendor integrations, Brand HQ branch management, customer scan flows, admin operations, and Supabase Edge Functions. The backend is hosted on Supabase; frontend deployments on Vercel can serve this Swagger page as a static asset.

post.summary: Create a customer, vendor, or Brand HQ account
post.description: Creates a Supabase Auth user. Role and account metadata determine whether the app routes the user to the customer dashboard, vendor dashboard, or Brand HQ dashboard.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Pass query parameter `grant_type=password`. The returned access token is used for dashboard table access and session-authenticated Edge Functions.

put.summary: Update current user's auth profile or password

get.summary: List or fetch profiles by role, slug, or id
get.description: Used across routing and dashboards. RLS restricts rows by role: customers see themselves; vendors/branches see themselves; Brand HQ sees its organisation; admins see platform records.

patch.summary: Update profile, storefront settings, plan, custom domain, webhook URL, or brand identity

get.description: Used by storefronts, customer product shop, vendor catalogue, Brand HQ branch products, and admin safety review.

post.description: Vendors create their own products. Brand HQ may create products for branches under its organisation. New products enter Anovra safety review before public display.

patch.summary: Update product details or safety status

get.description: Customers see their own analyses. Vendors/branches see scan activity for their storefront. Brand HQ sees scans from branches under the brand. Admins see platform-wide scans.

post.description: Called after `analyse-skin` returns AI results. The row connects customer, vendor or branch, selected area, image URL, AI output, and recommendations.

post.description: Accepts base64 image data or a storage image URL plus selected skin area. Returns structured skin concern, result, score, severity array, and benefits.
Answers skincare-only questions using a constrained Gemini prompt. Unrelated topics are declined.

post.description: Used by catalogue forms to extract ingredients, benefits, usage, disadvantages, and warnings from uploaded product labels.

post.summary: Generate or rotate live vendor API key
post.description: Requires a Supabase session bearer token. Revokes existing active key for the account and returns the full new key once.

post.summary: Create or update Brand HQ branch account
post.description: Brand admins create branch/vendor accounts under their brand and can update branch profile, email, phone, location, and access status.
Sends configured email templates through Resend and logs delivery status. Admin alert templates route to admin@anovra.africa.

post.description: Internal function used after scans, purchases, product flags, and catalogue updates. Attempts are written to webhook_delivery_logs.
